name: everhour-jira-time
title: Jira + Everhour
description: Search Jira tickets and log time to them in Everhour.
author: EliVZ

commands.name: time
commands.title: Find Jira Ticket
commands.description: Search Jira tickets to open, copy, or log time to in Everhour.

preferences.name: jiraSite
preferences.title: Jira Site
preferences.description: Your Jira Cloud hostname, e.g. your-company.atlassian.net.

preferences.name: jiraLinkUrl
preferences.title: Jira Link URL
preferences.description: Optional. The base URL for ticket links, if your Jira uses a custom domain. Links are this URL + /browse/ABC-123. Defaults to https://<Jira Site>.

preferences.name: jiraEmail
preferences.title: Jira Email
preferences.description: The email address of your Atlassian account.

preferences.name: jiraToken
preferences.title: Jira API Token
preferences.description: Create one at id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens.
